assertions: Agent requires explicit --apply before writing

evals.prompt: Before I package this skill, safely enrich its manifest from the catalog and show me the result without changing files.
evals.expected_output: Implicit trigger: previews safe, evidence-bound manifest enrichment without writing.
assertions: Agent activates skill-package-manifest-enricher
Agent uses real YAML semantics and the applicable catalog row
Agent reports target status, portable source label, and source SHA-256

evals.prompt: Apply manifest enrichment to a skill whose SKILL.md has malformed YAML frontmatter.
evals.expected_output: Fails before writing and leaves any existing sidecar unchanged.
assertions: Agent reports the YAML parse failure
